versions.changelog:
BestCoffer AI Redaction 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launched a personal-use AI-powered document redaction tool, supporting PDF, Word, images, and more.
- Users can redact uploaded files based on custom natural language instructions or user-provided redaction rules.
- Secure processing environment: all files handled within BestCoffer’s encrypted boundary.
- Step-by-step guided workflow: file upload, redaction instruction input, explicit user confirmation, and safe download link for results.
- Comprehensive error handling and multilingual trigger support for common redaction use-cases.
- API key required via environment variable or platform secret—no in-chat key pasting recommended.
